name: Computer Engineering
boundaries: Computer Engineering: fundamental discoveries and enabling technologies within this field. Include cross-field consequences where the central advance belongs to this field; exclude routine incremental optimization. Use the historical breakthroughs in the prompt to calibrate revolutionary impact.

original_dispositions.original_title: Scalable beyond-CMOS logic with sub-5 mV/decade swing and high drive at room temperature
original_dispositions.reason: Neighbor to CPE-02 and CPE-08, and not either of them. A steeper swing is a device-roadmap goal and does not by itself entail the historical processor-level consequences or a new computer.

original_dispositions.original_title: Monolithic 3D integration with unlimited active layers and zero thermal or alignment penalty
original_dispositions.reason: Overlaps the ambitions of CPE-03 and CPE-08 and does not replace them. Unlimited active layers with zero thermal penalty depend on much lower energy per operation or cooling that has not been shown to erase the constraint.

original_dispositions.original_title: Practical reversible computing hardware at scale
original_dispositions.reason: The historical phrase “arbitrarily close to the Landauer limit” for arbitrary computation was narrowed in CPE-02 using Earley’s rate-dependent bound. The concept was not replaced.

original_dispositions.original_title: Human-brain-scale neuromorphic fabric at biological energy
original_dispositions.reason: The single-chip requirement and the unverified “~20 watts” slogan were clarified. The concept was not replaced.

original_dispositions.original_title: Monolithic photonic-electronic platform with zero-latency conversion
original_dispositions.reason: Covered in part by CPE-04. The historical item is the weaker hybrid-interconnect goal. CPE-04 keeps the unmet general-purpose optical computer with optical memory. No second ID was created.

original_dispositions.original_title: Intrinsic hardware root of trust immune to all physical and side-channel attacks, and proved against supply-chain tampering
original_dispositions.reason: Proofs hold inside a stated model and do not confer immunity to every physical attack and fabrication-time modification. Closing remaining classes would matter for security but would not create a new kind of computation or a Bessemer-scale change in the cost of computing.

original_dispositions.original_title: Universal memory with DRAM speed, flash density, non-volatility, sub-nanosecond access, endurance above 10¹⁵ cycles, and scaling below 1 nm
original_dispositions.reason: A cell with all of those extremes would help CPE-03, but the missing discovery is a memory device and the numerical combination was not tied to a verified requirement. On the evidence found, it is not a new principle of computation at the calibration scale.

original_dispositions.original_title: Hardware that rewires itself at transistor granularity in picoseconds, with zero overhead, into the optimal accelerator for any workload
original_dispositions.reason: Rewiring has delay and energy. “Zero overhead” removes the tradeoff rather than discovering a machine. The universal-chip claim also swallows CPE-03, CPE-04, and CPE-05 without a separate mechanism.

original_dispositions.original_title: Practical cryogenic superconducting stack for data-center deployment
original_dispositions.reason: “Room-temperature deployment” was read as economic cooling in a data center, not as 300 K superconducting logic. The historical 1000× figure was not adopted as a criterion.

original_dispositions.original_title: Hardware that automatically extracts maximum parallelism from any sequential program and proves functional correctness
original_dispositions.reason: Maximum parallelism for arbitrary code with a proof for every program is not a single missing processor feature. Alias and dependence questions are undecidable in general, so a guaranteed optimum for every sequential program is not a credible hardware discovery.

reconciliation_change_log.change: All eight first-pass concepts and IDs were kept. None was deleted, replaced, or merged away. No new ID was assigned.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: The historical list’s ten items are either the same ideas or fall short of the revolutionary bar.

reconciliation_change_log.change: CPE-02 now states that historical item 3 is the same concept, and that “arbitrarily close to kT ln 2 at arbitrary speed” conflicts with Earley’s rate-dependent bound. The MANA citation now includes DOI 10.1109/JSSC.2020.3041338 and pages 1152–1165.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: The historical wording was stronger than the rate-dependent bound.

reconciliation_change_log.change: CPE-03 now cites the full Jonatan et al. paper, DOI 10.1145/3639046, and records the shorter SIGMETRICS DOI as an abstract companion.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: The earlier DOI uncertainty is closed.

reconciliation_change_log.change: CPE-04 now flags historical item 5 as a weaker hybrid-interconnect relative, without changing CPE-04 into that hybrid.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: The historical hybrid and the general-purpose optical computer overlap but are not identical.

reconciliation_change_log.change: CPE-05 now says a single chip is not required, and it declines to treat “~20 watts” as a verified measurement.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: A multi-die system at biological energy and scale would still count; the metabolic source states a fraction of body energy, not a watt measurement.

reconciliation_change_log.change: CPE-06 now separates the university press “about 80 times” cooling-inclusive comparison from a measured data-center result, and it records historical item 9 as the same concept under a clarified reading of “room-temperature deployment.”
reconciliation_change_log.reason: The press comparison concerns a small processor, not a measured data-center workload.

reconciliation_change_log.change: CPE-07 now uses the printed Kinos DOI 10.1103/frtv-p5zy and adds the open Azuma et al. review. Wehner’s full text remains unread.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: The Kinos PDF header prints that DOI; the Azuma source is an open review.

reconciliation_change_log.change: CPE-08 now explicitly refuses to absorb steep-slope switches or unlimited 3D stacking.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: A lithographic CMOS-scale switch or stack of ordinary transistors is not an atomic-pitch universal computer.

reconciliation_change_log.change: The historical source list was checked. Three cited URLs do not resolve to the documents named. IRDS and IEDM exist and do not, in the pages opened, certify that ten-item list.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: The historical answer’s claim that its ten items were explicitly the highest-priority unsolved challenges is not supported by those citations.
